record.basis: Sample application numbers and UCIs in the shape the product checks (1-2 letters then 8-9 digits; digits), never real ones. Submitted through the APR Portal (P-98), the combination's portal.

thin_case.basis: A second Visitor visa case opened on release 1 before release 2 goes out, to show a case staying on the release it started on (DEMO.md row 16). Only its principal is added; nothing is answered.

paper_line.basis: Tech lead's ruling (8 Nov 09:44 IST) and P-380 Q3: one person's IMM 5257 is filed on Paper, with a written reason, so the story keeps a barcode PDF that a person validates in Adobe. Its filing waits for that validated copy (P-315: a barcode form without one blocks Ready to file), so it is split out of the family's group with a reason and the other filings are recorded together (BR-11). Sample.
